meta.method: Share of a regular grid of points inside each boundary (about 2,000 per geography) lying within the radius of a stop, straight-line. 'confirmed' means CDOT or an agency feed publishes the stop; 'any' also counts OpenStreetMap-only stops. Private airport/hotel shuttle pickups are excluded: they are not public transit. Nearest stop is measured from a point inside the geography (its centre when that lies inside). When no sample is within the radius, nearest_confirmed_stop_to_boundary_miles gives the exact distance from the boundary, so a zero is proven, not sampled.
